day_shape: 69 items: CENTCOM launched fresh strikes on Iran to protect Hormuz shipping and E3 condemned Iranian attacks, IRGC/Defa Press claimed multiple hits on US bases in Kuwait/Bahrain/Oman, heavy Khamenei retaliation-messaging cycle, Lindsey Graham death noted, no UK Parliament items.

threads.label: US strikes and Hormuz freedom-of-navigation
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced fresh strikes on Iran from 5pm ET to degrade its ability to threaten commercial shipping, and stated the Strait of Hormuz remains open with US forces ensuring transit. Trump said the Strait is open to commercial traffic; Jerusalem Post cited shipping data showing transits at multi-week lows.

threads.label: Iranian claims of strikes on US regional bases
threads.summary: IRGC and Army public relations claimed via Defa Press and IRIB to have destroyed US facilities in Bahrain, radars in Oman, a missile base in Kuwait and an MQ-4C Triton drone over Bandar Abbas. CENTCOM rejected Iranian propaganda claims that three US service members were killed in Kuwait, saying all personnel are accounted for.

threads.label: E3 statement and Iranian rejection
threads.summary: The UK, France and Germany issued an E3 statement condemning Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and on regional countries. Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Bagheri dismissed the E3 statement as unjustified, saying Europeans have grown accustomed to following America.

threads.label: Khamenei revenge messaging and commemorations
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released excerpts from the Supreme Leader's message on the funeral of the "martyred leader" framing retaliation as a divine mission, and announced an Azadi Stadium commemoration for 23 Tir. Cleric Mohsen Araqi and SNSC deputy Bagheri Kani placed Trump and Netanyahu at the top of a retaliation list; Iran International noted hardliners emboldened by Mojtaba Khamenei's call for revenge.

threads.label: Iran diplomatic posture and retaliation framing
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Bagheri told a press conference Iran has given no country a blank cheque and that armed forces will decide response timing, while the ministry said sources of attacks on Iran are legitimate targets 25 days after the war-ending understanding. Defa Press published commentary on deterrence costs of not responding to assassinations.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and Lebanon operations
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck a Hamas weapons production site in Gaza City and killed operatives including Hassan Mustafa Zahir Al-Razina near the Yellow Line, citing ceasefire violations. Ambassador Yechiel Leiter said the IDF will only leave Lebanon once Hezbollah is removed from southern pilot zones; IDF Arabic spokesperson accused Hezbollah of turning Beaufort Castle into a stronghold with Iranian support.

threads.label: Lindsey Graham death reactions
threads.summary: Iran International reported Prince Reza Pahlavi's condolences on the death of US Senator Lindsey Graham, calling him a "steadfast friend of the Iranian people," with further Iranian opposition tributes noted by Jerusalem Post. Defa Press circulated an American journalist's sarcastic contrast between Graham's funeral turnout and the crowd at the Iranian leader's funeral.
